A message with an open "request change" review.

The check is on by default, with the severity `info`.

The check reports each message whose open review comments end in a change request, at the message in the reviewed locale. The quick fix resolves the request. A later approval by anyone clears it too. See [Reviews](/guide/reviews).

## Configure

Change the severity, or turn the check off, in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from '@x18n/core'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'review-changes-requested': 'off',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only review-changes-requested` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip review-changes-requested` skips it for one run.
